newsitem.title: FINLAND: SOCCER-JUVENTUS WORLD NUMBER ONE SAYS LITMANEN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUVENTUS WORLD NUMBER ONE SAYS LITMANEN.

text.p: Ajax striker Jari Litmanen believes that next Wednesday's European Cup semifinal opponents Juventus are the best team in the world.

Finland's best known player said the Italian club have improved since last year's final when they beat the Dutch holders. "The team has only got stronger. A couple of players have been changed but the core is the same," Litmanen was quoted as saying by Finnish newspaper Helsingin Sanomat on Friday.

Litmanen said he expected Juventus to squeeze him and fellow striker Patrick Kluivert between three players. "In any case, my role in the centre will be really tight," he said. "There is very little space and time."
